decisions.reason: The aloe vera line launched only in 2023 and already has its own web page, so its prospects are still uncertain, it costs little to keep, and dropping it before results come in would throw away the option's value.

The hyaluronic acid serum is a low-cost addition to a popular category and is still too new for its value to be judged, though its mere mention on the website suggests lower commitment and some risk of being pruned.

The cleansing milk is cheap to keep in a small cosmetics range and one year of evidence is not enough to show its value will not be realized, so the option stays open for now despite its low website prominence.
